title: SPO++: Stream-Aligned Policy Optimization for Asynchronous Agentic RL
abstract: arXiv:2608.24870v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Group-relative reinforcement learning waits for sibling rollouts of the same prompt, which is costly for long and variable tool-use trajectories. Single-stream Policy Optimization (SPO) removes this dependency with a persistent prompt-level value estimate, but its recipe whitens one advantage per trajectory before optimizing a token-mean actor loss. We show that trajectory centering generally does not center the token-weighted quantity consumed by the actor, and fix the mismatch by standardizing terminal-outcome advantages under the action-token measure. We additionally organize prompt evidence by the policy event that generated it rather than learner receipt order. Across matched runs on ALFWorld at two model scales and on Math-TIR, SPO++ improves online learning efficiency over SPO. A paired ablation identifies action-token-measure normalization as the strongest tested component.

translated_title: SPO++：面向异步智能体强化学习的流对齐策略优化
translated_abstract: 摘要：arXiv:2608.24870v1 公告类型：新 摘要：分组相对强化学习需要等待同一提示的兄弟轨迹完成，这对于长且多变的工具使用轨迹来说成本高昂。单流策略优化（SPO）通过持久的提示级价值估计消除了这一依赖，但其方法是在优化词元平均的actor损失之前，对每个轨迹的单一优势进行白化处理。我们表明，轨迹居中通常不会使actor所消耗的词元加权量居中，并通过在动作词元度量下标准化终端结果优势来修复这一不匹配。此外，我们根据生成提示证据的策略事件而非学习者接收顺序来组织提示证据。在ALFWorld的两个模型规模以及Math-TIR上的匹配运行中，SPO++相比SPO提升了在线学习效率。一项配对消融实验表明，动作词元度量归一化是最强的测试组件。
tldr: SPO++通过动作词元度量下的优势标准化和基于策略事件的组织方式，解决了SPO中轨迹居中与actor损失不匹配的问题，从而显著提升异步智能体强化学习的在线效率。
en_tdlr: SPO++ addresses the mismatch between trajectory centering and actor loss in SPO by standardizing advantages under the action-token measure and organizing prompt evidence by policy events, notably improving online learning efficiency in asynchronous agentic RL.
